review.intent: Retain the reviewed native fasthttp admission derivative while replacing a blanket replacement refusal with exact version, replacement-location and complete-tree integrity checks. Install the pinned guard update only after validating its old preimage, every new artifact and the complete source tree, preserving ingress protections and refusing source drift before writes.

evidence: Constructed sequence: hard-link the correctly pinned existing guard into a disposable stage from an original source tree; regular-file/type and byte/path digest checks pass because link count is not included; writing the update through either hard-link name changes the original source inode as well. This is specific to the new overwrite branch; the existing FILES path creates new targets with exclusive mode.
findings.suggested_fix: Before collecting an UPDATES target for writing, require its lstat().st_nlink to equal 1 (and retain the existing regular-file/preimage checks). Add an installer fixture linking the update target to a file outside the stage, then assert refusal before writes and that the outside file and all new targets remain unchanged.
findings.title: Hard-linked stage overwrites its original guard
findings.why_it_matters: Installing into a disposable stage prepared with hard-linked source files also modifies the original guard outside that stage. The old guard remains a regular file with the exact pinned bytes, so baseline and full-tree validation accept it; the new in-place overwrite then truncates the shared inode. Rejecting multiply linked update targets before any write keeps the original source untouched while preserving ordinary copied-stage installation.
findings.validation_reason: When the pinned update target is hard-linked to an outside file, _read (lines85-91) and _tree_digest (lines94-114) validate only type/content/path while the new target.write_bytes at line145 truncates the shared inode, so the diff newly exposes outside-stage modification; actual incidence was not independently measured under this read-only validation.
